architecture/service-boundaries.alt: Two contexts own separate aggregate streams and private persistence. Versioned public contracts cross the boundary.
architecture/service-boundaries.caption: Independent aggregate commits require explicit business coordination.

placement.heading: Return acceptance, then wait for the view

keiro/command-and-async-projections.alt: Command acceptance commits first. A subscription updates the rich view. A bounded position wait follows the commit.
keiro/command-and-async-projections.caption: A view timeout preserves the committed command receipt.

messaging/outbox-inbox.alt: The local transaction commits an outbox decision. Network publication can repeat. The consumer commits effect and inbox receipt together.
messaging/outbox-inbox.caption: Stable message identity protects repeated delivery within the retention window.

keiro/workflow-recovery.alt: Completed steps and failure history remain in the journal. Repair and resurrection restore discovery, then replay skips completed effects.
keiro/workflow-recovery.caption: Resurrection changes lifecycle state while preserving failure history.

placement.heading: Rebuild a whole dependency group behind one fence

keiro/projection-rebuild.alt: The complete group is fenced while targets are prepared and replayed to one captured head. Failure keeps the group fenced.
keiro/projection-rebuild.caption: Promote only after every source and verification completes.

messaging/retry-and-checkpoint.alt: Success advances the checkpoint. Retry repeats the event. Dead-letter finalization audits and advances. Halt leaves the checkpoint unchanged.
messaging/retry-and-checkpoint.caption: A delivery decision determines whether the durable cursor moves.

architecture/generated-and-hand-owned.alt: A checked specification produces overwriteable generated modules and create-once application files. The consuming build follows the generated compilation contract.
architecture/generated-and-hand-owned.caption: Regeneration preserves application-owned holes and bindings.

placement.heading: Prefer composeChecked At Every Sequential Boundary

keiki/checked-composition.alt: Typed alignment checks connect two transducers within one durable identity. Mismatches and poisoned mappings are refused. Replay validation remains separate.
keiki/checked-composition.caption: A checked composition boundary does not prove opaque guard logic.

keiki/replay-and-hydration.alt: A multi-event edge updates registers at its head event. A page can end with queued tail events, then resume to a settled state.
keiki/replay-and-hydration.caption: Paged replay preserves pending events; strict replay requires a settled end.

keiki/exact-projection-domains.alt: Every real owner projects into the declared image. Every admitted key reconstructs an owner whose getter returns that key.
keiki/exact-projection-domains.caption: Test both domain laws before relying on exact verification.

kiroku/log-positions-and-cursors.alt: Stream versions are local and sequential. Global positions can have gaps. Reading after a cursor excludes it. Deletion can lower the visible head.
kiroku/log-positions-and-cursors.caption: Use the visible head for catch-up and the append frontier for store history.

placement.heading: Keep observation separate from lifecycle mutation

kiroku/checkpoint-observation.alt: One statement captures store cursor and all durable member checkpoints. Observation leaves missing subscriptions absent and does not choose lifecycle policy.
kiroku/checkpoint-observation.caption: Read inventory facts coherently; keep mutation explicit.

keiro/dead-timer-resume.alt: Authorized preflight precedes a guarded claim from Dead to firing. Work runs outside SQL. Token and lease guard completion; park or expiry recovery returns to Dead.
keiro/dead-timer-resume.caption: The lease fences ownership; external execution remains at least once.

placement.heading: Rebuild an incompatible schema beside the serving revision

keiro/revision-generation-promotion.alt: Serving V1 continues while staging V2 replays. A final writer fence and preparation precede one atomic promotion that advances the serving epoch.
keiro/revision-generation-promotion.caption: A retained V1 generation is not ready for rollback.

placement.heading: Gate on completeness, and opt into proof strength deliberately

keiro/behavior-obligations-and-evidence.alt: Spec obligations and executed witnesses reconcile into nine report buckets. The completeness gate rejects five defect sets. Unverified evidence remains honestly classified.
keiro/behavior-obligations-and-evidence.caption: Enable the stronger proof-strength gate only for suitable aggregates.

messaging/fifo-heads-and-ordering.alt: An invisible, delayed, or failed absolute head blocks successors in its own group. Another group can progress. One read takes at most one head per group.
messaging/fifo-heads-and-ordering.caption: Visibility leases require idempotent handlers even with FIFO heads.

placement.heading: Size the adapter budgets to the outage you plan to survive

messaging/connection-fault-retry-budget.alt: Released classification can refuse the first in-flight disconnect. Transient poll and ack failures have separate five-attempt defaults with 1.5 seconds of backoff. Exhaustion fails the worker.
messaging/connection-fault-retry-budget.caption: A lost enqueue reply requires bounded reconciliation by producer identity.

placement.heading: Treat Running after a crash as ambiguous

migrations/deployment-and-crash-recovery.alt: The 0032 rollout stops old timer writers before migration and upgrades all writers before enabling resume. A crash in nontransactional work requires evidence before audited repair.
migrations/deployment-and-crash-recovery.caption: Ledger verification and live-schema verification answer separate questions.

config/configuration-layers.alt: Files, mounted secrets, and explicit environment form an ordered source stack. The winning value is decoded without falling back from a malformed winner. Secret sensitivity follows the key.
config/configuration-layers.caption: Keep secret values out of diagnostics from every source.

reuse/evolution-gates.alt: Six gates run from compiler and specification checks through startup validation, real-log audits, and production evidence.
reuse/evolution-gates.caption: Each gate needs evidence from its own boundary.

placement.heading: Upcast A Structural Change One Version At A Time

reuse/event-envelope-upcast.alt: A stored version-one envelope passes through a complete upcaster chain before current-kind dispatch and field decoding.
reuse/event-envelope-upcast.caption: Complete every historical rung before decoding the current envelope.
